claims.evidence: No ruler, doorframe, or other object in photo to judge scale; screen size cannot be derived from the image.
No logo, badge, or model sticker visible anywhere on the panel or bezel in the photo.
Screen is off and no ports, stand, or interface are visible; smart capability cannot be seen from a single off-screen shot.

risks.risk: TV may not power on or display properly
risks.proof: Video of the TV being switched on showing a stable image or boot logo

risks.risk: Actual screen size may be smaller than claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the TV with a tape measure or known-size object (e.g., a door) alongside it
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest plausible size for this form factor

risks.risk: Brand may be misrepresented or a generic/rebadged panel
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brand logo, model/serial sticker, or back-panel label
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/generic TV, not Samsung premium

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote, stand, power cable) reduce usability
risks.proof: Photo showing remote, stand, and power cable together with the TV
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit with no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden screen defects (dead pixels, lines, burn-in) not visible when off
risks.proof: Photo or video of the screen displaying a bright single-color test pattern

risks.risk: Port and back-panel condition unknown (damage, missing HDMI/USB)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear panel showing all ports intact

proof_requests: Video of the TV powering on with a visible picture
Photo with a tape measure or reference object showing true screen size
Photo of included remote, stand, and power cable
Photo of the rear panel and ports
Photo/video of a solid-color test screen to check for dead pixels or lines
response.reason: The witness confirms only a generic flat-screen TV with no verifiable brand, size, or functional proof, so it must be priced at the worst case (unbranded, untested, accessory-less) until the requested proofs arrive.
